title: The chunk table of a dlv:morton layout is in ascending Morton key
description: The chunk indices (y, x) are interleaved least significant bit first, y, the first declared dimension, giving the lowest bit of each pair; keys of a chunk index 3, outside the real 3 x 3 chunks, take no entry. The table therefore lists the chunks (0,0) (1,0) (0,1) (1,1) (2,0) (2,1) (0,2) (1,2) (2,2), and the cell at row r and column c is byte c mod 2 of the chunk (r, c div 2). Read so, the cells are 0 to 17 in order.
